description.value: Hotel Zed Tofino is a boldly retro boutique hotel on the Tofino Inlet, designed as a 1970s fever dream complete with a mini disco, sunken living room, psychic's den, and hidden arcade. It promotes itself as home to the world's first bike path routed directly through the hotel lobby, making it a genuinely cycling-forward property. Situated seven minutes on foot from Chesterman Beach and ten minutes by bike from Tofino's shops and restaurants, it offers on-site dining at ROAR and a free outdoor BBQ at the Lanai.

address.value: 1258 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hotel Zed Tofino is an active, operating hotel with a live booking engine and consistent contact details. The most cycling-relevant passage — 'the world's first bike path that takes you right through the lobby' — was cut off before any detail on secure overnight storage appeared, so secure storage cannot be confirmed. On-site dining at ROAR and a free BBQ Lanai confirm nearby evening food; EV chargers (ChargePoint) are confirmed for electric vehicles but are not described as e-bike chargers. Contact page data (phone 250-725-2323, address 1258 Pacific Rim Hwy) matches OSM exactly.
concerns: Website content for the 'World's First Bike Through Lobby' section was truncated before any detail on bike storage or facilities was captured; a full fetch of that section may reveal confirmed amenities.
Two on-site ChargePoint EV chargers are confirmed, but the website describes them as for electric vehicles only — e-bike charging suitability is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with active booking system, confirmed contact details, and a distinctive cycling-focused design feature (bike path through the lobby); clearly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel's signature design feature — a bike path running through the lobby — is prominently promoted and highly relevant to cycling tourists, even though specific secure storage details were not captured in the available website text.
